You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From c8290f9f2e1d119512e1821fc13d1d145aa23f77 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Geert Uytterhoeven <geert+renesas@glider.be>
Date: Wed, 8 Feb 2017 19:00:43 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] ARM: dts: r8a7743: Fix SCIFB0 dmas indentation

Fixes: 809c013426914694 ("ARM: dts: r8a7743: add [H]SCIF{A|B} support")
Signed-off-by: Geert Uytterhoeven <geert+renesas@glider.be>
Signed-off-by: Simon Horman <horms+renesas@verge.net.au>
---
 arch/arm/boot/dts/r8a7743.dtsi | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/arch/arm/boot/dts/r8a7743.dtsi b/arch/arm/boot/dts/r8a7743.dtsi
index d8393b97768b..c166be2f18e0 100644
--- a/arch/arm/boot/dts/r8a7743.dtsi
+++ b/arch/arm/boot/dts/r8a7743.dtsi
@@ -277,7 +277,7 @@ scifb0: serial@e6c20000 {
 			clocks = <&cpg CPG_MOD 206>;
 			clock-names = "fck";
 			dmas = <&dmac0 0x3d>, <&dmac0 0x3e>,
-		       <&dmac1 0x3d>, <&dmac1 0x3e>;
+			       <&dmac1 0x3d>, <&dmac1 0x3e>;
 			dma-names = "tx", "rx", "tx", "rx";
 			power-domains = <&sysc R8A7743_PD_ALWAYS_ON>;
 			status = "disabled";
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by incorrect indentation in the device tree source file (DTS) for the R8A7743 ARM architecture. Specifically, the indentation of the DMA (Direct Memory Access) entries for the SCIFB0 (Serial Communication Interface) was inconsistent, which could lead to misinterpretation of the device tree structure by the system. Proper indentation is crucial in device trees as it affects the parsing and understanding of the hardware configuration, potentially resulting in incorrect behavior or failure to initialize the DMA channels correctly.

You are a programming expert.
    You will be given the root cause of a bug and  the corresponding patch.
    You need to extract the code statements that lead to the bug from  the patch, based on the root cause.

    
    Provide a response strictly in the following format:
    Code statements:
    <text1>
    <text2>
    <text3>
    <text4>
    ...
    <textN>

Root cause:
The bug was caused by incorrect indentation in the device tree source file (DTS) for the R8A7743 ARM architecture. Specifically, the indentation of the DMA (Direct Memory Access) entries for the SCIFB0 (Serial Communication Interface) was inconsistent, which could lead to misinterpretation of the device tree structure by the system. Proper indentation is crucial in device trees as it affects the parsing and understanding of the hardware configuration, potentially resulting in incorrect behavior or failure to initialize the DMA channels correctly.
